To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose a service composition design for persistent query tasks in service-oriented wireless sensor networks, (2) we propose two algorithms to derive the service composition solutions with minimum number of service composition changes and minimum service composition cost during the lifetime of the persistent query, and (3) we evaluate our algorithms using real-world sensor data and compare them with other algorithms in the literature.
we propose an energy efficient service composition solution for persistent query in service oriented wireless sensor networks.
we have proposed two algorithms to minimize the number of service compositions during the lifetime of persistent query tasks in service-oriented wireless sensor network.

service composition in service-oriented WSNs which is an essential issue for energy-efficient persistent queries.

the proposed algorithms are efficient in minimizing the number of required service compositions during the lifetime of the persistent query.

we propose a novel problem to study persistent query in WSN and provide an effective solution for it.

the energy consumption can be minimized by reducing the number of service compositions and by optimizing the service composition cost.
